description: This Java source file defines a final class AclInvalidException, a custom exception indicating that an Access Control List (ACL) on a Thing is invalid. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested builder class for constructing instances with a fluent API.

classes.name: AclInvalidException
